notes.title: Soulwander play steaming
notes.notes: [p][b]Introducing the Livestream for Our Upcoming Game, [i]Soulwander[/i][/b]  [/p][p]We’re excited to present a special livestream showcasing our in-development title, [i]Soulwander[/i].[/p][p][i]Soulwander[/i] is a unique action roguelike game that stands out with its striking black-and-white pixel art style. The game combines fast-paced combat with a mysterious, atmospheric world, offering a fresh visual and gameplay experience for fans of the genre.[/p][p]Even better, you can try it for yourself — a playable demo version is available now![/p]
